Oral Order
4 21-06-2023
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

Learned counsel for the petitioner is permitted to remove the defect(s), as pointed out by the office,
if any, within a period of four weeks from today.

Petitioner seeks bail who is in custody since 09.08.2022 in connection with Majhauliya P.S. Case No. 583 of 2022, F.I.R. dated 09.08.2022 for the offences punishable under Sections 399, 400, 401,
402, 403, 411, 413, 414, 420, 467, 468, 471, 472, 379, 384 and 120(B) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66(c) and 66(f) of Information Technology Act.

According to prosecution case, several ATM Cards, sim cards and bundles of rupees have been found from the bag of the petitioner and on interrogation he told that he is the active Patna High Court CR.
MISC . No.1866 of 2023(4) dt.21-06-2023 member of cyber thug
and they buy ATM cards from innocent people by luring them and commit cyber crime.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner has clean antecedent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.
He further submits that the allegation as alleged in the F.I.R. is false and fabricated and the petitioner has not committed any offences as alleged in the F.I.R.

He further submits that as per the recoverey of the ATM Cards are concerned, the police have planted Md. Kalimullah vs The State Of Bihar on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/16355455/
1 the same and shown that the recoverey has been made from the possession of the petitioner.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further submits that there is no complaint with regard to the lost ATM Cards which were recovered from the possession of the petitioner.
He further submits that there is non- compliance of Section 100 of Cr.P.C.
He further submits that the police after investigation submitted the charge sheet against the petitioner.
The petitioner is in custody since 09.08.2022.

The learned Additional Public Prosecutor on the basis of material available on record as well as case diary has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the petitioner and submits that out of 26 ATM cards recovered, 11 ATM Cards are of State Bank of India but the prosecution had not obtain any report from the State Bank of India regarding those 11 ATM Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.1866 of 2023(4) dt.21-06-2023 Cards.

Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bettiah, West Champaran in connection with Majhauliya P.S. Case No. 583 of 2022, subject to the following conditions:-
1. Petitioner shall co-operate in the trial and shall be properly represented on each and every date fixed by the court and shall remain physically present as directed by the court and on his absence on two consecutive dates without sufficient reason, his bail bond shall be cancelled by the Court below.
2. If the petitioner tampers with the evidence or the witnesses, in that case, the prosecution will be at liberty to move for cancellation of bail.
3.

entities.text: Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bettiah, West Champaran
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And further condition that the court below shall verify the criminal antecedent of the petitioner and in case at any stage it is found that the petitioner has concealed his criminal antecedent, the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.1866 of 2023(4)
dt.21-06-2023 court below shall take step for cancellation of bail bond of the petitioner.
However, the acceptance of bail bonds in terms of the above-mentioned order shall not be delayed for purpose of or in the name of verification.

(Rajesh Kumar Verma, J) Vanisha/-
